title: Reliable flood forecasts even where gauges are missing
summary: A model trained on 5,680 gauges improved average global forecast reliability from zero to five days: forecasts at days 4–5 were similar to or better than day-zero forecasts from GloFAS v4. Flood Hub covers more than 80 countries. F1 comparison across 2,092 basins for two-year return-period events; flash and urban floods remain to be covered.

evidence.tested: F1 scores were compared with GloFAS v4 for 2-year return-period events across 2,092 watersheds (2014-2023); reliability at 4-5 day lead times was similar to or better than GloFAS at day zero.
evidence.unknown: Coverage must expand to more locations, flash and urban floods are not yet covered, and the gain is average-level rather than uniform.
evidence.ai_role: Two sequential LSTMs with a mixture density output produce probabilistic streamflow forecasts, trained on 5,680 gauges.
